topic: ChatGPT Finances is now free in the US: how to try it safely
post:
ChatGPT can now read your bank accounts. For free. 💳
Here's how to try it, and the 3 settings to know first.

OpenAI just rolled out Finances in ChatGPT to Free and Go users in the US, on web, iOS and Android.

What it does:
You connect your accounts, and ChatGPT answers money questions using your real data, not generic advice.

How to try it 👇

1️⃣ Connect your bank and card accounts through Plaid
2️⃣ Optional: connect your Experian credit report
3️⃣ Ask questions like:
"What did I spend on food delivery last month?"
"Which subscriptions renew this week?"

What it can't do:
🚫 It can't move money or pay bills. Access is read-only.

Safety habits before you connect:
🔌 Disconnect anytime in Settings > Apps > Finances
🗑️ Disconnecting deletes synced data within 30 days, but NOT your old chats. Delete those separately.

Why it matters:
AI assistants are moving from general answers to answers about YOUR life. That's powerful, and it means privacy settings are now part of using AI well.

Practical takeaway:
Start with one account, ask one real question, and decide if it's worth it.
